svg.title: Permutation trace for ABC: the first two outputs and the next first-letter choice
svg.desc: Step 0: Start. Prefix empty. Unused letters ABC. Next untried choice A. Step 1: Select A. Prefix A. Unused letters BC. Next untried choice B. Step 2: Select B. Prefix AB. Unused letters C. Next untried choice C. Step 3: Select C. Prefix ABC. Unused letters none. Print ABC. Step 4: Undo C. Prefix AB. Unused letters C. All choices at this prefix have been tried; backtrack again. Step 5: Undo B. Prefix A. Unused letters BC. Next untried choice C. Step 6: Select C. Prefix AC. Unused letters B. Next untried choice B. Step 7: Select B. Prefix ACB. Unused letters none. Print ACB. Step 8: Undo B. Prefix AC. Unused letters B. All choices at this prefix have been tried; backtrack again. Step 9: Undo C. Prefix A. Unused letters BC. All choices at this prefix have been tried; backtrack again. Step 10: Undo A. Prefix empty. Unused letters ABC. Next untried choice B. Step 11: Select B. Prefix B. Unused letters AC. Next untried choice A. Output after step 11: ABC, ACB.
svg.text: Orange outline: position changed in this step.
